name: page-header-bento
issues: The variable space/11 is 64 in this frame but 128 in page-header, so it was left out of this import's variables and the top padding is a fixed 64px. Check whether the two frames use different variable modes.

Each image has a tiled texture fill under the photo (opacity 75%), which the photo only partly hides.
